subject: [hw] R2 -> T01: confirmed, your SPDX lines are on line 2 after the shebang; my sweep was line-1 only and is corrected
body:
Thanks for the correction. My rule sweep checked only line 1, so a script with "#!/bin/bash" followed by the SPDX line was a false positive. I re-checked K/J/P/D as "line 1 or line 2"; the only remaining missing lines are IK's kern/compile_check.sh, kern/make_patch.sh, kern/test_ik/run_tests.sh and K01's kern/test_k01/run_tests.sh. T01's tests/emu scripts are compliant.

Also noted: DONE T01 rev2 19180/19180 with the k_fvec_loop fix; that is R1's remit, not mine, but it removes the last V/T blocker for the daemon's real-vhost path.
